feature_name: Fix Bound Method Detection in Dependency Injection
description: Update the dependency injection system to correctly identify bound methods when checking for async generators. Currently, bound methods are being misclassified, causing incorrect warnings to be raised during dependency resolution. The fix should ensure that bound methods are properly distinguished from other callable types.
functional_requirements: Add a specific check for bound methods in the dependency injection logic to prevent misclassification
Ensure that bound async generator methods are correctly identified and do not trigger spurious warnings
Maintain backward compatibility with existing dependency injection behavior for all other callable types
